Services

What the chairs do

Tap a service for the details. No price list is posted online, so call (717) 963-4664 and the shop will quote you straight.

✂️HaircutClassic and modern cuts+
Consult at the chair, cut to how you wear it, finished with a clean neckline and sideburns. The shop's everyday work, done right.
🪒Fades & Line-UpsThe shop's signature work+
Skin fades, tapers, hard parts and crisp line-ups. It is lettered over the shop's own doorway: LINE-UPZ. The gallery below is the proof.
🧔Beard TrimShape, line and finish+
Beards shaped and lined to match the cut, edges cleaned up so it grows out neat.
🔥Men's ShaveStraight-razor finish+
A proper shave service from the shop's own service list, with the edges detailed by hand.
💈Head ShaveClean all over+
Full head shaves, smooth and even, finished with the same care as a cut.
⭐Kids CutsFirst cuts welcome+
Kids sit in the same chairs as everybody else here. Reviewers single out the patience with little ones, first cuts included.
